def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    initial_equity_index = 100.0
    fixed_rate = 0.03
    notional_amount = 100_000_000
    payment_frequency = 4

    # Three months have elapsed, so three quarterly payments remain
    remaining_pv_factors = [0.997506, 0.992556, 0.985222]

    fixed_payment = (fixed_rate * notional_amount) / payment_frequency
    present_value_fixed_leg = fixed_payment * sum(remaining_pv_factors)

    # Equity leg return required for the swap value to equal zero
    required_equity_return = present_value_fixed_leg / notional_amount
    equity_index_level = initial_equity_index * (1 + required_equity_return)

    # return answer
    return round(equity_index_level, 3)
